title: sddb-warning-time-tests: power and within-patient tests of HRV-based warning-time claims for ventricular fibrillation on the MIT-BIH SDDB benchmark
description: Code for the paper 'Between-database horizon tests are too weak to establish warning times for ventricular fibrillation from heart rate variability'. It computes HRV features from PhysioNet beat annotations (sddb, nsrdb, chfdb and the heart failure positive-control databases) and runs the horizon test, diseased controls, surrogate onsets, within-patient contrasts with permutation and drift controls, a power simulation with resampled patients (changes scaled to pooled and within-recording SD, size-adjusted thresholds), a same-patient drift control as primary test with its conditional power, Holm correction, a replication of a published segment-level design, and the heart failure positive control. PhysioNet data are not included; scripts/00_get_data.py downloads the annotation files.
